data.one_liner: Installs iOS or Android apps from within a Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a method to open the App Store or Google Play page for another app. On iOS it shows the store inside the app via SKStoreProductViewController; on Android it launches a market:// intent. Supports additional iOS parameters for affiliate and campaign tracking.
use_when: You need to prompt users to install another app from your app
You want an in‑app App Store view on iOS
You need a simple way to open Google Play from Flutter
avoid_when: You require a fully custom installation flow or UI
You need advanced store analytics beyond the provided parameters
You only need a plain URL launch (can use url_launcher)
strengths: iOS in‑app store view via SKStoreProductViewController
weaknesses: Limited to opening store pages, no download management
No fallback if store app is missing
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, run flutter pub get; on iOS ensure SKStoreProductViewController is available (no extra permissions). Android uses a standard intent, no extra manifest changes required.
